# Assembler aliases

[← dictionary index](index.md)

A mnemonic that assembles to another instruction (`FNEG32` and `FABS32` to an instruction with an operand of their own, and a `MOVQ` before it when the registers differ; `ROL` to `ROR` with the count complemented). One mnemonic is one instruction (section 9.18); the disassembler never prints an alias.

*Generated by `tools/mkmanual.py` from `spec/grammars.d`; do not edit.*

| Written | Assembles to | Group |
|---|---|---|
| `CBHIS` | `CBCC` | `cbranch` |
| `CBLO` | `CBCS` | `cbranch` |
| `FABS32` | `AND` with the operand `#0x7FFFFFFF` (after `MOVQ Rs, Rd` if the registers differ) | `alu` |
| `FNEG32` | `XOR` with the operand `#-2147483648` (after `MOVQ Rs, Rd` if the registers differ) | `alu` |
| `MULU` | `MUL` | `alu` |
| `ROL` | `ROR` with the count `#n` complemented to `#(64-n)` (a constant count only) | `besc` |
